title: Tanovo
intro: Brand identity for Tanovo, a Canadian platform where models, photographers and other creatives find each other, plan shoots and build their portfolios. A logo, a colourway, and everything a new app needs to go live.
brief: Tanovo was about to launch on the App Store and Google Play and needed an identity that works on a home screen: recognisable at any size, on any background. Two things were fixed from the start: the logo had to combine the letter T, a dot and an arch, and the navy and gold palette was already trademarked.
did: I explored nine directions and presented each as a real app icon in home-screen mockups, so the client could choose in context.

The final mark is built on a consistent construction grid and stays legible down to favicon size. Alongside it: a Noto Sans wordmark, horizontal and vertical lockups, and versions for dark, light and single-colour use.

The handover was a full launch package, from splash screens and store-ready icons to a colour system with developer tokens, documented in a branding guide so the team can find any file without asking.
